name: Heal Pulse
description: Restores 12 HP (+50% user SpA) to an ally within 1–2 tiles.

name: Soft-Boiled
description: Restores 50% Max HP to self or an adjacent ally.

name: Floral Healing
description: Restores 15 HP and cures Status Conditions on an ally within 1–2 tiles.

name: Wish
description: Restores 40% Max HP to self or an ally within 1–2 tiles.

name: Life Dew
description: Sprinkles wondrous water to restore 10 HP to an ally within 1–2 tiles.

name: Roost
description: Lands to rest wings, restoring 50% of the user's Max HP.

name: Rest
description: Restores 100% HP and clears prior status, putting the user to Sleep for 1 turn.

name: Thunder Wave
description: Inflicts Paralysis (PAR) on a foe within 1–2 tiles.

name: Will-O-Wisp
description: Inflicts Burn (BRN) on a foe within 1–2 tiles, halving its Physical damage.

name: Toxic
description: Inflicts Poison (PSN) on a foe within 1–2 tiles.

name: Hypnosis
description: Lulls a foe within 1–2 tiles into Sleep (SLP) for 1–2 turns.

name: Protect
description: Raises a personal ward reducing incoming attack damage by 8 until next turn.

name: Obstruct
description: Crosses arms to fortify a lane, reducing incoming damage by 8 until next turn.

name: Reflect
description: Erects a light barrier reducing Physical damage taken by 4 for 3 turns.

name: Light Screen
description: Erects a luminous wall reducing Special damage taken by 4 for 3 turns.

name: Teeter Step
description: Refreshes an adjacent ally who has already acted so they can act again.
